First, import shapefile verify geometric validity. Since boundary consists multiple polygons representing different park sections, merge single polygon using st_union(). reduce complexity file size, simplify boundary retaining vertices 200-meter intervals. GBIF requires polygon coordinates geographic (longitude/latitude) format rather projected coordinate systems. check current coordinate reference system transform WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), standard geographic coordinate system. title: Generation length for IUCN Red List assessments — rl_generation_length
text: method needs different input columns. Pass relevant columns unquoted (tidy-style); columns method actually uses need present. "mean_parent" (mean age parents) One row per newborn, holding age parent newborn produced. Generation length mean parental age. population stable age distribution, supply year: mean taken within year averaged across years. Columns: age (required), year (optional). "mean_reproduction" (mean age reproduction) Two input shapes accepted: event form: one cohort followed life, one row per breeding event age happened. Generation length mean ages. Columns: age. life-table form: one row per age survivorship lx age-specific fecundity mx. Generation length weighted mean age reproduction sum(x * lx * mx) / sum(lx * mx), reproduces result official IUCN generation length calculator. Columns: age, lx, mx. Supply lx mx use life-table form; omit event form. "half_reproduction" (50% reproductive output) Age individual reaches half lifetime reproductive output, averaged individuals. Output measured offspring produced; supply output. count breeding events works proxy every event yields number offspring. Two input shapes accepted: event form: one row per breeding event age column (id separate individuals); row counts one unit output output supplied; summarised form: one row per (id, age) output column giving offspring produced age. 50% age weighted median age: smallest age running total output reaches half individual's lifetime total. Reproductive output happens age, value age classes invented. Columns: age (required), id (required one individual), output (optional; omit one-event-per-row form). "replacement" (replacement rate) Time population grow net reproductive rate R0 = sum(lx * mx). intrinsic growth rate r population multiplies exp(r * t) unit time, T = log(R0) / r, r solves Euler-Lotka equation sum(exp(-r * x) * lx * mx) = 1. population essentially stationary (R0 close 1, r close 0) limit mean age reproduction sum(x * lx * mx) / sum(lx * mx), returned instead. Columns: age, lx, mx (required).
